'''''Hesperoyucca''''' is a small genus of two recognized species of [[flowering plant]]s closely related to, and recently split from, ''[[Yucca]]'', which is in the [[Agavoideae|century plant subfamily]] within the [[Asparagaceae|asparagus family]].<ref>{{citation |last=Stevens |first=P.F.  |title=Angiosperm Phylogeny Website: Asparagales: Agavoideae |url=http://www.mobot.org/mobot/research/apweb/orders/asparagalesweb.htm#Agavaceae }}</ref>

==Description==
''Hesperoyucca'' is distinct from ''Yucca'' in having [[Dehiscence (botany)#Septicidal and loculicidal dehiscence|loculicidally dehiscent]] [[fruit]] and a [[Scape (botany)|scape]] more than {{Convert abbreviated|2.5|cm|sigfig=1}} diameter with reflexed (not erect) bracts. The [[Stigma (botany)|stigma]] is [[Stigma (botany)#Shape|capitate]], whereas those of ''Yucca'' split into three reflexed lobes. The glutinous [[pollen]] is released in a sticky mass; that of ''Yucca'' species is released as single grains.<ref name=Agavaceae.com>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20120718044940/http://www.agavaceae.com/botanik/pflanzen/botanzeige_scan_en.asp?gnr=220&scan=22190&cat=5&name=Hesperoyucca%C2%A0newberryi|title=Agavaceae.com}} – page includes a key to''Yucca'' and the three recognized species of ''Hesperoyucca''</ref> The genus is native to [[Mexico]] and the southwestern [[United States]].<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=115253 Flora of North America, Vol. 26 Page 439, ''Hesperoyucca'' (Engelmann) Baker, Bull. ==Taxonomy==
The taxonomy of ''Hesperoyucca'' is complex and somewhat controversial.<ref name=Agavaceae.com/><ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=1&taxon_id=242101658 Flora of North America: ''Hesperoyucca'']</ref> Originally, in 1871, [[George Engelmann]] ranked "Hespero-Yucca" as a [[Section (botany)|section]] of ''Yucca'' (with only one member, ''Yucca whipplei''; all other ''Yucca'' species he placed in section Eu-Yucca, with three subgroups). In 1895 he revised his classification of ''Yucca'', to four equal groups, of which ''Hesperoyucca'' was one. In 1876, [[John Gilbert Baker]] gave it the rank of [[subgenus]]; in 1892 he noted that it "had better be kept as a genus distinct from ''Yucca''" (but actually retained the name ''Y. whippleii'' [sic]).<ref name=Agavaceae.com/>

Some authorities accept this as having erected the genus ''Hesperoyucca'', but others credit this to [[William Trelease]], who printed a taxonomic description in 1893, formally recognizing ''Hesperoyucca'' as being at the same rank as, but separate from, ''Yucca''.<ref name=Agavaceae.com/><ref>[http://www.ipni.org/ipni/idPlantNameSearch.do;jsessionid=FE8D88F2BF307B6B7A907D77EAF82444?id=24346-1&back_page=%2Fipni%2FeditAdvPlantNameSearch.do%3Bjsessionid%3DFE8D88F2BF307B6B7A907D77EAF82444%3Ffind_infragenus%3D%26find_isAPNIRecord%3Dtrue%26find_geoUnit%3D%26find_includePublicationAuthors%3Dtrue%26find_addedSince%3D%26find_family%3D%26find_genus%3DHesperoyucca%26find_sortByFamily%3Dtrue%26find_isGCIRecord%3Dtrue%26find_infrafamily%3D%26find_rankToReturn%3Dall%26find_publicationTitle%3D%26find_authorAbbrev%3D%26find_infraspecies%3D%26find_includeBasionymAuthors%3Dtrue%26find_modifiedSince%3D%26find_isIKRecord%3Dtrue%26find_species%3D%26output_format%3Dnormal IPNI] [[International Plant Names Index]]</ref> It has taken recent DNA analysis to confirm that they are indeed genetically distinct from ''Yucca''.<ref name=Agavaceae.com/>

The splitting of ''Hesperoyucca'' from ''Yucca'' is still not widely reflected in available literature or online (for example, the British [[Kew Gardens|Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew]] and the [[Royal Horticultural Society]] websites do not recognize the name as current).<ref>[http://www.kew.org/search/search?q=hesperoyucca&partialfields=&x=0&y=0&site=ext_kew&getfields=section&entqr=0&getfields=section&sort=date%3AD%3AL%3Ad1&output=xml_no_dtd&sitesearch-term=ext_kew&client=kew_website_frontend&ud=1&y=0&oe=UTF-8&ie=UTF-8&proxystylesheet=kew_website_frontend&x=0 RBG Kew search results for ''Hesperaloe'']{{Dead link|date=September 2018 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><!--retrieved 12 November 2009--><ref>[http://apps.rhs.org.uk/rhsplantfinder/ online Plant Finder] RHS [[Royal Horticultural Society]]</ref><!--retrieved 12 November 2009-->
